name: vm-manager
description: One inventory for your SSH servers, a native menu bar app, and supervised access for Claude agents.

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify src/cli.ts --outfile dist/vm && codesign --force --sign - --identifier app.vm-manager.cli dist/vm
scripts.install:local: bun run build && bun run build:app && ./dist/vm install --app "dist/VM Manager.app"
